name: Misaki Yua
source:
"Even if you know the real me... will you still love me?"

The reason why he joined the school was to change his shy personality. Although he likes to sing, he isn't good at dancing.

He had an accident in the past and has been dealing with memory problems ever since then.

Hobby: Walking, poetry
Favorite Food: Glasswork
Dislikes: Heights

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040207195018/http://www.will-game.com/BCM/gb01/char06.htm]official website[/url]]
